mapper.select: SELECT t_product_class.id, t_product_class.status AS status, t_product_class.product_class_no AS productClassNo, t_product_class.product_class_name AS productClassName, t_product_class.product_class_orders AS productClassOrders, t_product_class.main_or_byproduct AS mainOrByproduct, t_product_class.is_whp AS isWhp, t_product_class.parent_id AS parentId FROM t_product_class WHERE t_product_class.is_deleted = 0 AND t_product_class.parent_id = #{parentId}
